items.text: Buffalo (early week): IR - WR Joshua Palmer (hamstring). Questionable - LT Dion Dawkins (ribs) and LG Alec Anderson (ankle), both missed Wk9; NT Greg Gaines (calf); CB Christian Benford (wrist, left Wk9 and did not return). Monitor - TE Dalton Kincaid (ankle). Josh Allen starts.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (Bills vs. Jets injury update, Nov 10)

items.text: NY Jets (early week): Questionable - WR Garrett Wilson (concussion, missed Wk9), DE Joseph Ossai (ankle), CB Nahshon Wright (back), LB Trevin Wallace (groin). IR - DT T'Vondre Sweat, DT David Onyemata, T Max Mitchell. S Andre Cisco traded to DET. Geno Smith expected to start.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (Bills vs. Jets injury update, Nov 10)
